I am an AI/ML engineer working on generative AI products. I write about model evaluation, research engineering, and product-oriented ML experiments.

## What I study

I am working through image generation along three lines.

- **How generative models work and how they are designed.** Diffusion, flow matching, conditioning, architectures, and the relation between training and sampling.
- **Controllable generation and evaluation.** Spatial conditions, consistency, and how to tell whether generated data is good.
- **3D, video, and world models.** Geometry, cameras, and consistency across views and time.

## How this site is organized

Everything here is a note. Each note is one of three kinds.

- **Fundamentals** connect the ideas that foundational papers share.
- **Paper reviews** explain what a recent paper proposes, and what its results do and do not show.
- **Experiments** record reproductions and checks, including the ones that did not work.

Topics appear as tags on each note. New notes are also available through the [RSS feed](notes.xml).
